# Blaze — Arena FPS

> Mobile-first browser arena FPS. Solo vs AI soldiers, or live 5-minute multiplayer deathmatch rooms. No install, no sign-up — pick a callsign and play.

- Live game: https://blaze.itzash110099-e54.workers.dev/
- How to play: enter a callsign, pick a loadout (Assault Rifle / SMG / Sniper), press PLAY for solo vs 2 AI soldiers, or CREATE/JOIN a room for live multiplayer (Sector 04, 5:00 rounds, auto respawn).
- Controls: WASD + mouse, Space = jump, C = slide, Esc = pause. Touch controls on mobile.
- Tech: Three.js client, Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects multiplayer backend.
